events.title: Microsoft Fabric: A Technical Update for Public Healthcare Organisations
events.description: Technical webinar on Microsoft Fabric for healthcare and public sector organisations

events.title: A Practical Guide to the P to F-SKU Transition for Healthcare
events.description: Understand Microsoft’s move from Power BI Premium (P-SKUs) to Microsoft Fabric (F-SKUs) and what it means for healthcare organisations

events.title: Unlocking Value with Microsoft 365 Copilot in the NHS
events.description: A practical NHS-focused webinar on building the governance, use cases, user enablement, sponsorship and measurement needed for safe, sustainable Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption.

events.title: Data Track 1: SQL Server Modernisation & Extended Security Updates
events.description: SQL Server 2016 reached End of Support on 14 July 2026, creating important security, compliance and operational considerations for organisations still running legacy database workloads. In this session, we will explore the options available to customers.

events.title: AI Track 1: Introduction to Microsoft AI & AI in Healthcare
events.description: Introduction to Microsoft's AI platform, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry and healthcare solutions.

events.title: Data Track 2: Data Integration & Engineering in Fabric
events.description: Explore how Fabric simplifies data integration and engineering. Learn how to connect, transform, and manage data efficiently across your organisation using a unified platform.

events.title: AI Track 2: Microsoft AI Copilot Chat, M365 Copilot Premium, Cowork and Microsoft Scout
events.description: Dive deeper into Microsoft's AI assistants at work to transform productivity, streamline workflows and help teams work smarter.

events.title: Data Track 3: Data Analytics and Copilot in Fabric
events.description: Turn data into actionable insights with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric. Discover how Copilot accelerates analytics, reporting, and business intelligence development.

events.title: AI Track 3: From Copilots to Agentic Solutions - Microsoft Foundry vs. Copilot Studio
events.description: Compare Microsoft Foundry and Copilot Studio, pro-code and low-code approaches for building agents, grounding them in enterprise data, and orchestrating agent interactions.

events.title: Data Track 4: Preparing Data for the AI Era with Fabric Intelligence with Fabric IQ
events.description: High-quality data is the foundation of successful AI. Learn how Fabric Intelligence helps organisations prepare, govern, and optimise data for AI-powered solutions.

events.title: AI Track 4: Agent Governance - Responsible AI
events.description: Explore responsible AI principles, governance frameworks, and how to build secure, compliant, and trustworthy agentic solutions.

events.title: Data Track 5: Updates from FabCon/SQLCon
events.description: Get a curated summary of the most important announcements, product updates, and success stories from the Fabric and SQL conference events.

events.title: AI Track 5: AI Updates from Microsoft Ignite
events.description: End the year with the latest AI innovations from Microsoft Ignite. Discover new capabilities, roadmap updates, and practical opportunities for your organisation in the year ahead.
